description: This Java class provides helper methods for integrating with a Credit Bureau service within the Fineract project. It allows retrieval of credit reports and uploading of credit report files, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: CreditBureauIntegrationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing credit bureau API interactions used in integration tests within the Fineract project.

methods.name: CreditBureauIntegrationHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing request and response specifications for API requests.

methods.name: getCreditReport
methods.description: Retrieves a credit report from the credit bureau service via a POST request.

methods.name: uploadCreditReport
methods.description: Uploads a credit report file to the credit bureau service.

methods.name: createGetCreditReportAsJson
methods.description: Creates JSON payload with credit bureau ID and NRC for credit report retrieval.
